about: The pain clinic identifies the reason for methadone and the admission record accounts for the February gap before active ileus was documented on 20 March.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about paralytic ileus during the six-month oxycodone course, so request routine confirmation.
Palexia SR (tapentadol) is supplied every month, but the record says the paralytic ileus resolved in 2024 with no recurrence.
